title: Final Momentum Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final momentum of the K-meson as p_K = 0.82 GeV/c.

title: Energy Conservation Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly write and apply the energy conservation equation involving the energies of K and pi mesons.

title: Momentum Conservation Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must state and utilize the momentum conservation principle for the decay process.

title: False Statement Explanation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the statement as false and provide a valid explanation regarding the production of K- mesons.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect application of conservation laws or miscalculating the momentum.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios related to the decay process.
